events.verdict: Black (ORL) brushes Jones' (CHI) left arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Black (ORL) and Jones (CHI) come together at the same spot and incidental foot to foot contact occurs.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests Bane's (ORL) shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) moves alongside Vucevic's (CHI) path as he defends the drive.
Buzelis (CHI) moves alongside Wagner's (ORL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Black (ORL) cleanly blocks Giddey's (CHI)  jump shot attempt.
Black (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bulls.
Black (ORL) directly contests Buzelis' (CHI) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Buzelis' hand after the release.
Carter Jr. (ORL) establishes himself in Jones' (CHI) path prior to the contact.

Replay review of the foul called on Bane (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful.  Dosunmu (CHI) does not establish a legal guarding position in Bane's path prior to the contact, and the foul is overturned to a shooting foul on Dosunmu.
Bane (ORL) is moving alongside Buzelis' (CHI) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Isaac (ORL) deflects the ball away from Dosunmu (CHI).
Dosunmu (CHI) loses control of the ball on his own and not as the result of any contact from Black (ORL) or Isaac (ORL).
